AllMyPrinters
Your printers, from anywhere
Open the AllMyPrinters agent from your home network in any browser, also on the go. Pair this device once:

Open the agent at home in your browser, for example http://your-nas:8090.
Go to Settings → Pair devices and tap Add device.
Scan the QR code with this device, or copy the link and paste it below.
